fields.notes:
Balarāma was from the Suvarṇa clan of the Radhi ethnic group in Bengal. He was a resident of Kheturī and his brothers name was Rūpanārāyaṇa Cakravartī. Balarāma took initiation from Narottama Ṭhākura, after receiving the instruction to do so in a dream. He wasentrusted with the responsibility for serving the Deity worshipped by Narottama and became well-known as Balarāma Pūjārī. (Narottamavilāsa 11, Premavilāsa 19).

As the servant of Narottama's Deity he was known as «Balarāma Pūjārī». The record «Balarāma Pūjārī» #86 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

Taken out of the record «Kamsari Ghoṣa» #660, which mixed several persons (07-11-2026).

«Saṁvarāri» (the genealogies' name of Kaṁsāri Sena, father of Sadāśiva Kavirāja; Candraprabhā, Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). The record «Samvarari» #1350 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

Lord Caitanya; studied under Vidyāvācaspati, Paramānanda Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmabhādra and Vidyābhūṣaṇa
One of the six Gosvāmīs of Vṛndāvana. In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Rati Mañjarī (also said to be Rāga or Lavanga Mañjarī). Brothers: Rūpa and Anupama (Vallabha); nephew: Jīva Gosvāmī. Grandfather: Mukunda; father: Kumaradeva; family of Karnataka brāhmaṇas. Prime minister (Dabir Khas) of Sultan Hussain Saḥ of Gauḍa. Met Lord Caitanya at Rāmakeli; imprisoned by the Saḥ, escaped and was taught by the Lord for two months in Kāśī. Ordered to write books, establish Vaiṣṇava behaviour and Deity worship and rediscover the holy places of Vraja.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Rati-mañjarī, also called Lavaṅga-mañjarī; Sanātana Kumāra also entered him (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 181-182).

«Sarkār Mallik»: Sanātana Gosvāmī's name before, in the Muslim government. The record «Sarkar Mallika» #1380 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

He had three sons: Balarāma, Janārdana and Murāri.

A resident of Śrīhaṭṭa (Sylhet), he was the brāhmaṇa pilgrim who worshipped Balagopala. Lord Gaurāṅga showered His mercy upon him by accepting the rice cooked by him. He had  three sons named Balarāma, Janārdana and Murāri. Balarāma was the initiated disciple of Lord Nityānanda and a Vaiṣṇava poet. The Deity of  Balagopala is worshipped at Sripata Dogachia.

He is the «pilgrim brāhmaṇa» (tairthika) of the Nāmāmṛta-samudra (214). The record «Tairthika Brāhmaṇa» #1544 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

fields.aka: Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Mahārāja, Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura Prabhupāda, Bimala Prasāda Datta, Siddhānta Sarasvatī, Vimalāprasāda Datta
fields.notes:
Bimala Prasāda, son of Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura and Bhāgavatī Devī, born in Purī in 1874. Title Siddhānta Sarasvatī for his astronomy. Dīkṣā from Gaura Kiśora dāsa Bābājī at Godruma (1900); chanted a billion names at Māyāpura from 1905; defeated the smārtas at Midnapore (1911). Took tridaṇḍa-sannyāsa himself before his guru's picture at Māyāpura (1918). Founded the Gauḍīya Maṭha: sixty-four maṭhas in India, Rangoon and London; sent sannyāsīs to Europe (1933). Left the world on 1 January 1937 in Calcutta.

The record «Siddantha Sarawati» #1405, which held only the list of his books, was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

«Vimalāprasāda Datta» was his name before sannyāsa. The record «VIMALĀPRASĀDA Datta» #1690 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
